name: extract_field
description: Extract a single field's value from a supplier source document using the LLM's own reading of the document text. Returns the extracted value and a confidence indicator. Does not validate, reconcile, or compute anything - use check_consistency for validation.

document_id.description: Identifier of the cbam.source.document record to read from.

field_name.description: Which field to extract, matching the declaration line / synthetic-data ground-truth schema.
